name: Hagia Sophia
description: A sixth-century dome still dominates Sultanahmet. The vast interior shifts between museum and mosque eras of use.

name: Blue Mosque
description: Sultan Ahmed’s mosque faces Hagia Sophia with cascading domes and six minarets. The prayer hall is tiled in blue Iznik work.

name: Topkapı Palace
description: Ottoman sultans’ palace overlooks the Golden Horn. Courtyards lead to the treasury and tiled privy chambers.

name: Göreme Open-Air Museum
description: Rock-cut churches and frescoes fill a valley of fairy chimneys. Paths link chapels carved into soft tuff.

name: Library of Celsus
description: The reconstructed façade of a Roman library anchors Ephesus’s Curetes Street. Columns and niches face the crowd of visitors.

name: Grand Bazaar
description: Covered streets of shops sell carpets, lamps and jewellery in one of the world’s oldest markets.

name: Bosphorus cruise shore
description: Ferries and boats stitch Europe and Asia across the strait. Waterfront palaces and tea gardens line both banks.

name: Pamukkale
description: White travertine terraces step down a hillside above Hierapolis. Thermal water pools collect on the calcium shelves.

name: Kaleiçi
description: Antalya’s old harbour quarter mixes Ottoman houses, cafés and a Roman gate by the marina.

name: Mount Nemrut
description: Colossal stone heads sit on a funerary mound at dawn and dusk. The summit is reached by mountain roads.

name: Spice Bazaar
description: Egyptian Bazaar stalls sell spices, lokum and dried fruit beside the Golden Horn.

name: Kadıköy market streets
description: Asian-side produce streets and meze counters make Kadıköy a favourite for casual eating.

name: Ciya Sofrası
description: A Kadıköy restaurant known for regional Anatolian dishes beyond standard tourist menus.

name: Baklava stalls of Gaziantep
description: Gaziantep is renowned for pistachio baklava; pastry shops cluster around the old centre.

name: Balık-ekmek Eminönü
description: Grilled fish sandwiches are sold from boats and stalls by the Galata Bridge ferry docks.

name: Istanbul Tulip Festival
description: Each spring, parks across Istanbul are planted with tulip beds celebrating the flower’s Ottoman link.
